full_details: Richard is one and twenty, and nothing was sent. At Paul's, under the cloister and out of this hour's drizzle, the first book of the Civil Wars was too dear at two shillings. Daniel has Richard ride captive behind his cousin, and a queen at a window who is a woman, where the chronicle had a girl of ten. Harrison would let you read and not wear the book out. You did not buy it. In the evening Gilbert called from St Bride's, the shop shut, and read a shop-ticket twice. He named the other baker, the shoemaker and the whittawer. He called it near five pound. He did not ask you to pay. You are for home in a fortnight, and the horse is still not bespoken.
one_sentence: You read Daniel standing at Paul's, and heard Gilbert add your father's three shops to near five pound.
title: Gilbert called the debts near five pound
